newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Telstra debate not likely before Oct 28 - govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Telstra debate not likely before Oct 28 - govt.

text.p: The proposed partial sale of Australian government-owned telecoms carrier Telstra Corp was unlikely to be debated in the upper house of parliament before October 28, a Senate source said on Wednesday.
The Senate is not due to debate the Telstra bill until after it has considered the government's industrial relations bill.
"I would think it would not be the next sitting, but maybe the sitting after because the next sitting will be industrial relations," a government source told Reuters.
